commands.cmd: rm -rf /tmp/cp-deploy && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Control-Point-FTC/control-point.git /tmp/cp-deploy 2>&1 | tail -1 && git -C /tmp/cp-deploy rev-parse HEAD && ls -la /tmp/cp-deploy/server/predict/how-it-works.html

sudo cp /tmp/cp-deploy/server/predict/how-it-works.html /opt/control-point/server/predict/how-it-works.html && sudo chown controlpoint:controlpoint /opt/control-point/server/predict/how-it-works.html && sudo chmod 644 /opt/control-point/server/predict/how-it-works.html && sudo cmp /tmp/cp-deploy/server/predict/how-it-works.html /opt/control-point/server/predict/how-it-works.html && echo COPIED_OK
sudo systemctl restart control-point && sleep 5 && sudo systemctl is-active control-point
